title: Barbarian: fear, freeze, root and Ignore Pain
description: In rifts, let Nightmarish elites fear you, hazards freeze you and Jailers root you: each lands for its time and shows as a debuff. With Ignore Pain up, none of them lands, and casting Ignore Pain while feared or frozen breaks it at once. With the Vanguard passive, the speed bonus shows once, not twice.

title: Wizard: freeze bonuses and Armors
description: The Frozen and Chilled damage bonuses apply only while the target visibly has the slow or freeze, and Bone Chill only after a freeze actually landed. Cast a second Armor: the first one falls off.
